brief.claim: In a recording of 200 cortical neurons, the neurons that fire least at baseline show an increase in firing rate after the manipulation of at least 2 spikes/s on average. The claim holds when a one-sample t-test of the per-neuron increase against zero, over the low-baseline neurons, is significant at p < 0.05 (one-sided) and the mean increase is at least 2.

data_keys.meaning: mean firing rate in spikes/s in two separate pre-manipulation epochs of equal length
mean firing rate in spikes/s in the epoch after the manipulation
